class.name: HTMLBehavior
class.brief_description: Base class for project scripts attached to an HTML label.
class.description: Extend this class with a GDScript that can be constructed without arguments. Add the script resource to [member HTMLLabel.behavior_scripts] and enable [member HTMLLabel.behaviors_enabled]. An HTML script element with type [code]text/gdscript[/code] selects a registered script by its [code]src[/code] name.

method.name: _attach
method.description: Called after the host's document has been laid out. Use [param label] to query elements and connect signals.

method.name: _detach
method.description: Called when the behavior is detached. Disconnect signals and cancel work started by the behavior here. During document replacement, the old DOM is still available from the host.
